metadata.scenario: A company representative calls to get a quote for providing on-site wellness services to their employees. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Edward Martinez. I’m calling because I’d like to request a quote for on-site wellness services for my company. Hi, Edward! I’m glad you called. Can you tell me a bit more about the services you’re interested in? Sure, we’re looking for wellness services that could include health screenings and maybe some educational workshops for our employees. Great, we can definitely provide those. How many employees are you looking to service? We have about 50 employees at our office. Thank you for that information. Would you be looking for a one-time event or recurring services? I think we’d prefer something ongoing, maybe quarterly. That sounds good. For ongoing services, we can offer health screenings, workshops, and even fitness programs. That sounds perfect. Can you give me an idea of the pricing for that? Sure! For health screenings, we charge about $65 per employee. Workshops typically range from $150 to $300 depending on the topic. Okay, and how about fitness programs? Our fitness programs are about $110 to $140 per session, lasting 45 to 60 minutes. Got it. And do you offer any packages for multiple services? Yes, we can create customized packages that might offer a discount for bundling services. That would be great. Could you send me a detailed quote? Absolutely! Could you provide me with your email address so I can send that over? Yes, it’s edward.martinez@company.com. Thank you, Edward. I’ll send you that detailed quote by the end of the day. Perfect, thank you! Is there a contact number if I have further questions? Yes, you can reach me directly at +13165559201. Great! I appreciate your help today. You’re very welcome! I look forward to working with you. Thanks again, Margaret. Talk soon! Talk soon, Edward. Have a great day!
